dataset.title: Efficiency of mechanical ventilation on H2 dispersion (PS)

reader.layout_rule: Locate Pu/mbar, x/ mm and the average/maximum/minimum concentration blocks from the workbook headers; do not assume rows are time samples.
reader.output_unit: hydrogen concentration in vol percent, spatial coordinates in mm, flow in g/s

confirmatory_plan.case_selection: Freeze the workbook and sheet identifiers before numerical model output is inspected; retain at least one no-wind, co-flow, counter-flow and cross-flow case for each release diameter.
confirmatory_plan.primary_endpoint: Spatial concentration-field error at the declared x/y sampling points.
confirmatory_plan.negative_result_policy: A failed case remains archived and does not support a validated ventilation or detector-placement claim. This dataset cannot close the gaseous HRS full-loop gate.

claim_boundary: This protocol evaluates confined-space mechanical-ventilation and hydrogen-dispersion behavior only. It does not validate vehicle filling, cascade dispatch, compressor or precooler control, dispenser protocol, SOC, or full-station pressure dynamics.
